title: Best habit tracker
body:
I absolutely adore this app. It syncs with apple health, I love how it looks and the reminder notifications are non intrusive. The widgets are fantastic and actually help me to remember my tasks, and has helped me with simple things like keeping my water intake up. You can customise and personalise how you achieve your goals and the units they use. For example, I want to drink 1000mls a day and I can add 50 mls throughout the day until I reach the 1000ml mark. And if you don’t complete the full goal, it still counts as progress if you’ve done some of the goal. The subscription isn’t all that expensive, I bought the lifetime and it is well worth it. Thank you for making this app!

Edit: my only critique is that my sleep info often does not sync with apple health, despite it being enabled

title: Simply Remarkable
body:
I’ve tried so many methods of habit tracking from whiteboards to excel spreadsheets to notebooks to digital diaries and nothing has lasted. 

This app is absolutely brilliant. I can choose what my habits are, what each habit’s colour is, what category it’s in, what days I’ll be reminded on, what time I’ll be reminded at on the relevant days and can view in depth statistics about how I’m tracking and what my achievement rate is. Honestly I’m constantly amazed at the level of thought that has been put into this app, and for free?? Amazing. 

My two favourite features, however, are:

1. Inspirational Quotes
- nothing motivates you to stick to your habits like being reminded of why you want to develop a habit and being able to write a quote in that will pop up everyday when I am reminded to do my task is an incredibly powerful motivator.

2. Streaks
- one of the most successful ways to make anyone complete anything is to make it into a game and something that’s enjoyable which is exactly what streaks do. Finally, the addictive and meaningless Snapchat streaks concept has been repurposed to something that perpetuates your motivation with tangible results - the higher your streak, the more motivated you become to maintain your task completion, the better your habits, the more you develop, the better your life gets. Really.

I simply couldn’t recommend this app more. Everything you need, everything you didn’t realise you needed, and nothing surplus or superfluous. Honestly, do your life a favour and give it a go. 

Huge thanks to the developers, this app is very well thought through, beautifully laid out, and incredibly useful. Keep up the amazing work 👏🏼
